issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2 IG, ViewDefinition.select.column.type: type 'must be provided if a ViewDefinition returns a non-primitive type'; Boolean is a FHIR primitive
issues.evidence: VD {resource: Patient, constant:[{name:V, valueBoolean:true}], select:[{column:[{name:v, path:'%V'}]}]} generates SQL whose runtime guard rejects the row: "column 'v' path '%V' violates collection=false / type unset; non-primitive outputs require column.type". String/decimal/integer literal constant columns pass without column.type. Reproducer: /mnt/d/fhir4ds/.temp/qa/sofvd02_explorer/probe4.py. Root cause: resolved path 'true' matches _SIMPLE_FHIRPATH_NAV_RE so the runtime type-guard branch is used, whose declared_type=None allowed set is _PRIMITIVE_TYPE_NAMES only (lowercase FHIR names, no System names) while type().name returns 'Boolean'.
issues.root_cause: generator.py _SIMPLE_FHIRPATH_NAV_RE matches bare boolean literals; runtime guard allowed set for type-unset columns omits System primitive type names (Boolean).
issues.resolution: generator.py _path_supports_runtime_type_guard: bare true/false literals routed to expression complex guard

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2 IG StructureDefinition-ViewDefinition (constant.name: sql-name only; no rule about builtin FHIRPath variables); FHIRPath environment variables %resource/%context/%rootResource/%ucum
issues.evidence: constant name 'resource' parses OK; %resource in a path is silently NOT substituted with the user constant (builtin wins) — gender = %resource evaluated false where user value 'female' would be true. Probes in probe2.py 'e2e user const named resource'. Deterministic, documented in constants.py, but silent.
issues.root_cause: constants.py resolve_constants_in_path checks FHIRPATH_BUILTIN_VARIABLES first; no parse-time rejection or warning for shadowing constant names.
issues.resolution: Spec-silent; recommend upstream clarification; parse-time warning/error candidate
